edges.reason: The orange wall banner marks the building entrance; the iron door is inside the main hall behind the entrance
The redstone block physically walls off the left wing passage and is only reachable after entering through the iron door area
The cobblestone blockade in the right wing corridor is only reachable after entering the main hall past the iron door
Mining either redstone block (2-high barrier) creates a gap to access the left wing bedroom containing the gray bed
Mining either redstone block (2-high barrier) opens access to the ice storage room deeper in the left wing
The full-width mossy cobblestone wall barrier at z=-8 is only reachable after clearing the cobblestone blockade at z=-5
The chiseled red sandstone chamber at z=-11/-12 is only accessible after breaking through the full-width mossy cobblestone wall
